parsed_json.reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by updating the `length_by_path` dictionary with `length_by_edge` directly, which overwrote existing values. The fix is to update only the values that are not already set to infinity.

modifications.code: length_by_path.update({(i, j): length_by_edge[(i, j)] for i, j in length_by_edge if length_by_path[(i, j)] == float('inf')})
